On this page

Module: Student Dashboard ​

Module ID: student-dashboard
Area: Student-only dashboard for overview stats, instructor discovery, booking/payment flows, profile management, help/support, progress tracking, ratings, and chat.

How to identify this module ​

  • Every file inside docs/modules/student-dashboard/ belongs to the Student Dashboard module.
  • The file name tells you the exact feature being documented.

Deep docs in this module ​

DocFeatureRoute / SurfaceContents
overview-analytics.mdOverview analytics/student-dashboard/overviewStudent stats cards, weekly lessons table, instructor notes, and dashboard query flow.
search-instructors.mdSearch instructors/student-dashboard/search, /student-dashboard/search/instructors/:idInstructor discovery, filters, map/list, instructor detail, booking entry flow.
booked-lessons.mdBooked lessons and checkout recovery/student-dashboard/book, /student-dashboard/booking-details, /student-dashboard/complete-paymentBooking tabs, checkout completion, T-48 payment completion, cancel/refund actions.
profile-setting.mdProfile setting/student-dashboard/settings, /student-dashboard/settings/edit-profileStudent profile view/edit flow, image upload, address suggestions, lesson history surface.
help-support.mdHelp & support/student-dashboard/help-supportFAQ viewer and support contact form.
payment-history.mdPayment history/student-dashboard/payment-historyStudent transaction ledger, stats, filters, refund visibility, pagination.
progress-tracking.mdProgress tracking/student-dashboard/reviews, /student-dashboard/allBookingSlots, related review routesProgress cards, remaining hours, booking-slot table, lesson progress queries.
feedback-rating.mdFeedback & rating/student-dashboard/Feedback, /student-dashboard/review-form, /student-dashboard/review-displayStudent-to-instructor reviews and lesson-level feedback/rating flow.
messages-chat.mdMessages / chat/student-dashboard/chatStudent chat layout, conversation sourcing, GraphQL messaging, Socket.IO real-time behavior.

Shared student shell ​

  • Layout: Frontend/src/layouts/StudentLayout.tsx
  • Route wrapper: Frontend/src/routes/StudentRoutes.tsx
  • Route declarations: Frontend/src/routes/index.tsx
  • Auth guard: StudentPrivateRoute
  • Shared context: Frontend/src/context/AuthContext.tsx
  • Shared sidebar/top-nav: Frontend/src/components/common/SideBar.tsx, Frontend/src/components/common/DashNavBar.tsx
  • Shared notifications/socket wiring: Frontend/src/utils/useBookingNotification.ts, Frontend/src/hooks/useSockets.ts, Frontend/src/utils/socket.ts

Notes ​

  • Several student flows span multiple routes but belong to one feature. Example: booked lessons also owns booking details, checkout return handling, and T-48 payment completion.
  • Some student screens reuse shared or teacher-side components (for example help/support and parts of the review system). The deep docs call those out explicitly so developers know when a change affects more than one dashboard.
  • The route /student-dashboard/Feedback is capitalized in the current implementation; the docs preserve that exact route because it is part of the live codebase.
